mandates.duty_text: The commissioner shall submit an annual report to the mayor and the council identifying which park facilities under the commissioner's jurisdiction comply with the standards for accessible design of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, including specified information for each listed facility.

deadline.text: By no later than December first of 2015

mandates.duty_text: Set annual recreation center membership fees for veterans and persons with disabilities at no greater than 20 percent of the highest annual membership fee for adults who are not veterans or persons with disabilities.

deadline.text: This local law takes effect 120 days after it becomes law.

mandates.duty_text: The commissioner shall promulgate rules identifying at least six parks in each borough under the department’s jurisdiction to be considered a public place and determining the quantity and location of automated external defibrillators to be placed in such parks.
mandates.citation: Section 2, subdivision e of section 17-188 of the administrative code

mandates.agency: department of housing preservation and development
mandates.duty_text: Within thirty days of identifying a distressed building for participation in the alternative enforcement program, provide written notification to the building owner, occupants, and the council member in whose district the building is located.

deadline.text: within thirty days of identifying a distressed building

mandates.citation: §3, subdivision g(i) of section 27-2153 of the administrative code

mandates.agency: Commissioner of Housing Preservation and Development
mandates.duty_text: Take measures necessary to implement the local law, including promulgating rules, before its effective date.
